name: streaming-speed-control
description: Zero-build Manifest V3 browser extension for playback speed on HBO Max, Netflix, Hulu, Prime Video, Disney+, Paramount+ and Peacock.

scripts.check: node --check src/shared/speed-utils.js && node --check src/content/page-hook.js && node --check src/content/video-controller.js && node --check src/content/overlay-ui.js && node --check src/content/main.js && node --check src/popup/popup.js && node --check src/background/service-worker.js && node --check scripts/generate-icons.mjs && node --check scripts/screenshots/capture.mjs
scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && zip -qr dist/streaming-speed-control-v$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json src icons LICENSE -x '*.DS_Store'
